run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-18T00:51:42Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: Evidence indicates that the frontend-proxy request errors are the downstream symptom of a failed rollout of the checkout Deployment in namespace otel-demo. At 00:51:49–00:51:59 the checkout Deployment (revision 2, generation 4) rolled out a new ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 whose pod template image is the invalid string "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" (embedded newline). The old ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) was scaled to 0, and pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 is stuck Pending with container waiting reason InvalidImageName; the checkout Service has only notReadyAddresses. checkout span volume dropped from ~5181–5398 spans/10m before the change to 524 spans/10m, frontend's error spans are confined to POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect, and the frontend-proxy access log shows POST /api/checkout returning 500 via_upstream while other endpoints return 200. The frontend-proxy error-span ratio moved from ≤0.00091 before 00:51:42 to 0.0141 (window ending 00:53:42) and 0.055–0.063 from 00:57:42 on, matching the alert. frontend and frontend-proxy pods themselves are Running, ready with 0 restarts and only the checkout path fails, so they are the alerting/affected reporters rather than the cause. The checkout Deployment pod template is the object that holds the fault; who or what applied it is unknown (change_history integration not available).

claims.text: frontend-proxy error spans (status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR) jumped from background levels of ~1–6 spans per 10m in windows ending at or before 00:51:42 to 344 (window ending 00:56:42), 755.8 (01:01:42) and 424.3 (01:06:42), while STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans stayed ~14k–14.7k per 10m in the same windows.

The frontend-proxy error spans are on span_name "ingress" and "router frontend egress": 1.05 before the change (window ending 00:51:42), then 172.63 and 171.58 (window ending 00:56:42), 378.95 and 376.84 (01:01:42), 213.25 and 211.08 (01:06:42); "router frontend egress" had 0 errors before the change.

The frontend-proxy error-span ratio (errors / all spans, 4m increase) was 0 to 0.00091 through the evaluation at 00:51:42, then 0.01406 at 00:53:42, 0.04399 at 00:55:42, 0.062996 at 00:57:42, 0.05536 at 00:59:42, 0.05550 at 01:01:42 and 0.05868 at 01:03:42.

frontend service error spans in the 10m window ending 01:01:42 were confined to span_name POST (373.68), POST /api/checkout (373.68), executing api route (pages) /api/checkout (373.68), grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (373.68) and tcp.connect (20); GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/cart, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart all showed 0 error spans in the same window.

frontend-proxy access logs sampled from 00:59:19.811Z to 00:59:31.949Z show "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream responses (e.g. 500 with 21 response bytes) interleaved with 200 responses for /api/products/*, /api/cart, /api/recommendations and /api/data.

checkout service span volume was 5181.05 spans/10m in the window ending 00:41:42 and 5397.89 in the window ending 00:51:42, then fell to 524.21 in the window ending 01:01:42; no checkout series with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR was returned in that query.

Deployment otel-demo/checkout (deployment.kubernetes.io/revision "2", metadata.generation 4, observedGeneration 4) has spec.template.spec.containers[0] name checkout with image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" and an init container wait-for-kafka from busybox:latest.

Deployment otel-demo/checkout status at 01:13:35: replicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1, availableReplicas and readyReplicas absent, condition Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since lastTransitionTime 2026-11-18T00:51:59Z.

ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 was created 2026-11-18T00:51:49Z by Deployment checkout with image "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" and has replicas 1, while the older ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, created 00:13:44Z) was scaled to replicas 0.

Events for Deployment checkout show ScalingReplicaSet "Scaled up replica set checkout-d75b77f99 from 0 to 1" at 00:51:49–00:51:59 and "Scaled down replica set checkout-5dccddf8bb from 1 to 0" at 00:51:52, with Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq killed at 00:51:52; ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 created pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 at 00:51:59.

Warning events for pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68: reason InspectFailed 27 times (00:52:01–00:57:13) with message 'Failed to apply default image tag "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": couldn't parse image name "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": invalid reference format', and reason Failed with "Error: InvalidImageName" 12 times (00:52:01–00:54:03).

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (created 2026-11-18T00:51:59Z) is Pending, container checkout ready=false with state.waiting.reason InvalidImageName and the message 'Failed to apply default image tag "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": couldn't parse image name "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": invalid reference format'; the Ready condition is ContainersNotReady since 00:51:59Z.

The checkout Service endpoints object lists only notReadyAddresses: pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (uid f40c293c-c909-4144-bd5b-1c9df3aaf0dd) on port tcp-service 8080, i.e. no ready backend address for checkout.
Pods frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-t9gll were created 00:13:45Z and 00:13:44Z (before the incident), are Running with container ready=true and restartCount 0 at 01:13:35.

Only one pod in otel-demo was not Running at 01:13:35 (checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68, Pending/InvalidImageName); the other 20 pods were Running and ready with restartCount 0, except fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-xwg9b which shows restartCount 1.

In the 10m window ending 01:01:42 the only services with error spans above ~1 span/10m were frontend (1514.74) and frontend-proxy (755.79); accounting, cart and payment had 0 and ad, recommendation and fraud-detection had ~1.05 each.

The flagd-config ConfigMap read at 01:13:14 (demo.flagd.json) sets every flag's defaultVariant to "off" for all 15 flags it defines (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure), so no enabled fault-injection flag is visible in the current flag configuration; the value in effect at 00:51 is not proven by this read.

The applied fault is the checkout Deployment's pod-template image value "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": the embedded newline makes the reference unparsable, so the kubelet never starts the container (InvalidImageName), checkout loses its only replica at 00:51:52, frontend's CheckoutService/PlaceOrder gRPC calls and tcp.connect fail, frontend answers 500 on /api/checkout, and frontend-proxy's ingress errors (its own 5xx) drive RequestErrorRate above 0 for service_name frontend-proxy.

Rejected: the frontend or frontend-proxy workload itself broke. Both pods are Running, ready with 0 restarts and predate the incident, frontend errors are confined to the /api/checkout and CheckoutService/PlaceOrder paths, and frontend-proxy kept returning 200 for products, cart, recommendations and data in the same log sample.

Rejected: an application-level checkout failure (e.g. payment/cart dependency or a flagd-injected failure) produced the 500s. The checkout container never started because its image reference is invalid, checkout spans fell to 524/10m, and every flag in flagd-config has defaultVariant "off".

Set Deployment otel-demo/checkout's container image back to the previously running valid image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout (the image of ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb) and let the rollout complete, then confirm the checkout pod becomes Ready, the checkout Service gains a ready endpoint and the frontend-proxy error-span ratio returns to its pre-00:51:42 baseline.

Trace how the checkout image value with an embedded newline reached the Deployment manifest (Helm release otel-demo — annotation meta.helm.sh/release-name=otel-demo — or the pipeline that rendered it), since no change-history source is integrated in this Run.

gaps: change_history integration is not available, so who or what changed Deployment otel-demo/checkout's image, and when it was applied before the 00:51:49 pod creation, cannot be established.

Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend (00:52:00–01:05:00) nor frontend-proxy (00:50:00–01:00:00 and 00:45:00–01:12:38); the queries returned nothing, so the traced status codes and error messages behind the measured 500s / STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans were not observed and span counts come from traces_span_metrics_calls_total only.

Prometheus queries for kube_deployment_status_replicas_available, kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready (via kube_deployment.* name match), kube_replicaset_owner, kube_pod_owner and kube_pod_container_info returned no series in the window, so Kubernetes state over time is known only from API objects observed at 01:13 and from events, not from KSM time series.

A kubernetes_jq_query for kind networkpolicies in namespace otel-demo returned nothing (no_data), so whether a NetworkPolicy exists that could refuse frontend→checkout traffic is unchecked rather than ruled out.
Pod logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 returned no lines for 00:50:00–01:00:00, so frontend's own application log statement for the checkout failure was not read.
The alert rule definition was not retrievable: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name RequestErrorRate returned nothing (no_data), so how RequestErrorRate is computed is unverified.
fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-xwg9b shows restartCount 1 with an unknown restart time; it is not tied to this cause and its change timing could not be placed in the window.
Whether the invalid image string "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" was an intentional fault-injection experiment cannot be determined from the available data.
next_steps: Correct the checkout container image to a valid reference and let the Deployment rollout finish, then re-check the frontend-proxy error-span ratio and the checkout Service endpoints.
Review the deployment pipeline / Helm values for the otel-demo release to find where the newline entered the checkout image value, since change history is not integrated here.
Confirm with the alert rule owner that RequestErrorRate is computed from frontend-proxy span status counts, as the rule definition was not retrievable.
